additional_info.subject: RE: ID0370395-DC/Si-D/BE- [d3fZDR] IMD error, outlet 2 not available CRM:00796000688
additional_info.body:
Hello
﻿Lorenz Wojtowski,
we hope this email finds you well.
Upon reviewing the logs, we observed that there was a timeout in IMD_DC2's self-check to the Modbus within the designated time frame. We have resolved this issue, and as of now, there are no active error flags, indicating that the charger is in a healthy state. Could you please confirm this status? If everything is satisfactory, we kindly request permission to close this ticket. Should you require further assistance or have any additional questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. Our team is available and eager to address any concerns you may have.
Thank you for your patience, and we look forward to your prompt response.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
